_meta.purpose: Podcaster persona + idealistic/pragmatic axis.  Cognitive-stance axis (vision-first vs constraint-first).  Podcaster is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.00, n=4).  The trait poles' questions are largely identical hot-topic prompts; the axis modulates whether the response paints the best possible outcome or the realistic compromised path.  Question mix: 5 idealistic-trait big-policy prompts + 4 pragmatic-trait same-shaped prompts + 1 podcaster-role media probe + 2 extraction power + 2 hand-written named-tradeoff.
